itineraries.title: Five days among the Îles d’Hyères
itineraries.intro: Porquerolles, Port-Cros and the Maures coast.

days.note: The citadel, the Place des Lices and the harbour front at aperitif hour.
A calm bay beneath the Maures hills; the beaches west towards Le Rayol.
The national park island; swims at Palud.

itineraries.title: Seven days from Marseille to Saint-Tropez
itineraries.intro: The calanques, the Îles d’Hyères and the Maures.

days.note: The Vieux Port, Le Panier and the view from Notre-Dame de la Garde.
The Château d’If and the coves of the Frioul islands, a short hop from the city.
The finest of the calanques, its white cliffs above a narrow turquoise inlet.
The vineyards behind the town and the island of Bendor in the bay.
Cycle the island’s tracks to Notre-Dame beach; anchor for the night off the village.
The national park island: the underwater trail at La Palud and the fort walks.
The citadel, the Place des Lices and the harbour front at aperitif hour.
